patch_list: Adds a button that triggers the same action as shaking your phone would.
Adds an "Export GPX" item to the activity overflow menu, which saves the activity's GPS track as a GPX file in Downloads/Strava.
Extends the full-screen media viewer menu with items to copy or open their URLs or download them directly.
Allows exporting and downloading Strava routes as GPX or TCX files directly from the app.
Blocks Snowplow analytics. See https://snowplow.io for more information.
Prevents the Quick Edit prompt from popping up.
Re-enables password login after having used an OTP code.
Hides elements that are not essential.
Overwrites the compression, resize and trim media (images and videos) parameters returned by Strava's server before upload.

patch_list: Long-press the Home tab in Strava's bottom bar to open 'Morphe patch settings'. Lets you toggle feed cleanup, route trim, bottom bar tabs and the launcher name/icon at runtime, without re-patching.

Changes the app's displayed name and launcher icon. The icon choices are Strava's own built-in alternate icons, plus an accent-colored one. Name and icon can later be switched at runtime from the patch settings screen.
Replaces Strava's brand orange (#FC5200) accent color in the app's native screens with a color of your choice.
Shows the email and password login option instead of forcing the one-time email code flow. Your password is still checked by Strava's servers exactly as in the official app.
Hides who-to-follow suggestions, suggested challenges and other clutter cards from the activity feed. Requires the 'Hide subscription promotions' patch, which provides the shared feed filtering.
Hides subscription upsell modules and promotional cards from the feed and other modular screens. UI cleanup only: does not unlock any paid features.

Renames the launcher label (Settings > Apps, home screen) to the value of the stravaAppName option. Leave the option empty to keep the original name.
Registers the Extra Settings activity and applies the accent color.
Adds an 'Extra Settings' entry at the top of Settings with theme mode switching and patch info. Accent color is a build-time option.
Strips Sentry, Embrace and Facebook analytics, disables Firebase analytics, and empties the advertising ID (push notifications keep working).
